explanation: I read every theorem in Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Arsinh.lean. It has no lemma bounding |arsinh x| by |x|, and there is no Lipschitz or contraction statement for arsinh. The only other file that mentions arsinh is the upper half-plane metric file. The closest ingredients are `Real.self_le_sinh_iff`, `Real.abs_sinh` and `Real.sinh_arsinh`. Combining them would give the result, roughly by taking y = arsinh x, so |x| = |sinh y| = sinh |y| ≥ |y|. That needs several separate Mathlib declarations rather than one, so I did not count it as a special case.
